listing.name: The Warriors (Xbox) — The Warriors - XBERecomp (Antriksh1984)
listing.summary: The alpha is reported to boot and play the opening missions with correct audio. The full game has not been played through; later crashes, missing effects and broken sound remain possible. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC original Xbox The Warriors retail disc as ISO or extracted data. PS2, PSP and PAL editions are rejected. This guide does not include the supported default.xbe digest; check the project’s importer or configuration requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s alpha release and importer with your own ISO and assets. First launch compiles game code locally with XboxXBERecomp. The player targets Windows 10/11 x64 with D3D12 and XAudio2. The recorded review did not run compiler commands.

warnings: The alpha is reported to boot and play the opening missions with correct audio. The full game has not been played through; later crashes, missing effects and broken sound remain possible.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
